title: Normal-R4 promotion audit
kind: read-only audit; no production code changed
verdict_reason: Normal-R4 has no Track 1 slot and no live candidate path. Six named code gaps must be closed in 5M-B before any shadow evidence can exist. The collision, IBKR and state risks are all manageable and none of them is a blocker; the blocker is that the sleeve is not wired at all.

blockers.measured: keys are roska4_calm and roska4_stress only; sleeves_at('14:05') returns []
blockers.effect: candidates() raises no_sleeve_at_this_instant at every swing slot instant

blockers.measured: 25 slots, sleeves {roska4_calm, roska4_stress}; built by _calm_slots() + _stress_slots(), not derived from WINDOWS_ET generally
blockers.effect: no swing slot exists to register, and the dashboard mirror reads this same tuple so neither side has one
there is no live candidate path for Normal-R4 at all

blockers.measured: keys are roska4_calm and roska4_stress only
blockers.effect: the admission gate has no bar-size, no decision window and no prior-RTH rule for swing, so window_verdict cannot pass or fail it
coverage can never be judged complete, so the runbook precondition a shadow period is measured against cannot turn green
documentation gap only; the 14:20 stop-repair sweep is ALREADY excluded because hour 14 is the legacy R4 window

collision_runtime.mutexes: SEPARATE. _slot_lock serialises legacy; a private _t1_lock serialises Track 1 against itself. Neither blocks the other - by design

legacy_runtime_measured.note: the worst observed run uses 97% of the slot window

collision_runtime.track1_swing_runtime: NOT MEASURED - no Track 1 slot has ever run in production
collision_runtime.risk: two child processes at the same minute, each fetching history from one Gateway

ibkr_provider.collision: none on client id - measured from the CLI defaults on both sides
ibkr_provider.stale_comment: run_scheduler:1090 still says the Track 1 shadow route 'opens no broker connection'. Stage 5I wired --bar-provider ibkr and build_bar_provider calls broker.connect(). The comment is now false; the separate-mutex decision it justifies is still defensible on other grounds
ibkr_provider.residual: historical-data pacing is per account, not per client id - unmeasured
ibkr_provider.disconnect: the entry point disconnects in a finally, defensively

state_checkpoint.good_news: the route checkpoint ALREADY covers roska4_swing; no schema work needed
state_checkpoint.kill_switch: Track 1 reads STOP_TRADING.track1, NOT the root STOP_TRADING. The root switch that stops legacy does NOT stop Track 1 shadow slots - which is what makes a clean shadow measurement possible, and is worth stating because it is the opposite of what an operator would assume
state_checkpoint.route_env: RAITS_ROUTE=track1_candidate is stamped by _run(route=...) on Track 1 children and defaults to 'legacy' otherwise

dashboard_ops.mirror: monitor/backend/schedule_status imports TRACK1_SLOTS directly, so adding swing slots there updates the scheduler and the mirror together
dashboard_ops.parity: parity_report() true today with the flag off and on; must be re-run after 5M-B
dashboard_ops.stop_repair: hours 2 and 14 already excluded; 12 excluded when Track 1 stress is live. A 14:05-15:55 swing window needs NO new exclusion
dashboard_ops.ops: monitor/ops.py --track1-shadow needs no change; it passes a flag, not a slot list

stop_semantics.arm: entry day + 1 day + 14:05 in the sleeve's own session clock; hits strictly before that instant are DISCARDED, and the first bar at or after it arms permanently
stop_semantics.gap_fill_rule: fill at the bar OPEN when the triggering bar is gap-eligible AND opened beyond the stop; otherwise fill at the stop price
stop_semantics.correction: I expected the 14:05 bar never to be gap-eligible under the production law, because a continuous session has no >15-minute break before it. Measured: 36 of 194 MES sessions. The hypothesis was wrong
stop_semantics.residual_live_vs_backtest: on the other 158 sessions the arm bar is NOT gap-eligible, so if the market is already through the stop at 14:05 the backtest books the STOP price while a live STP armed at that moment would fill at the prevailing market. Measured cost on this window: zero trades. Structurally present, and it belongs in the 5M-B execution-semantics section
stop_semantics.identity_separation: live/shadow uses production law via track1_params.LIVE_FILL_LAW; artifact reproduction asks for FILL_ARTIFACT by name (Stage 5M-1)

recommended_path.chosen: B - mirror the legacy cadence exactly, shadow only, separate mutex
recommended_path.why: it is the only option that preserves the measured entry timing, and the timing IS the sleeve: the arm is defined at 14:05 and entries are taken on the resume bar

options.option: A direct slots at the same minutes
options.ops_risk: highest - two children per minute against one Gateway

options.option: B same minutes, shadow only, separate mutex, provider none first
options.ops_risk: low first, then medium once the provider is on

options.cost: a slot that decides after the window has moved
